caveats: This is the independently adopted three-segment/six-foot redesign, not a repair of the legacy individual. The old one-piece bean body,four feet,three large back scales and fan tail are replaced. The earlier triangular two-foot and hexagonal three-foot/crescent branches were not image references. Catalog ID and name Korohanui are retained only as existing labels; visual identity and the old name-associated design meaning are not asserted unchanged. Legacy root normal,pixel and metadata are retained unchanged; no game code or catalog definition is modified here.

New anatomy: three rounded low rectangular scaly body blocks F/M/R in a straight front-to-back train,joined by two short broad cream smooth connections. Each block owns one left/right pair of short cream feet,six total. Exactly two eyes belong only to the front end face of F. No separate head,arms,wings or tail. The rear end face of R has blue-gray small scales. The adopted images use soft-rounded blocks and rounded scaly feet rather than an exact dimensioned mechanical block model.

The accepted new S normal is the visual identity baseline. Front eyes are visible in S/SE/SW and narrowly visible together at the rounded front end in E/W; rear views NE/N/NW have no visible eyes. Rear blue-gray end color is clearest in NE/N/NW and appears at the far end rim in some side/front-oblique views. The extent of that colored surface was visually compared,not established from a measured texture map.

These are approximate representative views,not verified exact45-degree rotations,strict90-degree side views or a fixed rigid3D camera rig. E/W remain slightly front-oblique. NE/NW and SE/SW have different axis angles and camera pitch; NW andSE appear steeper than their opposite obliques. Apparent segment size,roundness and top-surface exposure vary with perspective. Assets are independently fitted proportionally to longest-extent specifications,not a proven common world scale.

Six feet are assigned by the new design and demonstrated in the frontal/back views,while side views andSW hide most far-side feet. SE shows more far-side foot fragments thanSW. Hidden roots,exact equal limb lengths and complete3D occlusion geometry are unverified. No extra visible foot is required merely to make the count six in every frame.

Each selected pixel used only its matching selected normal as its sole image reference. Round small scales become angular or diamond-like clusters; shading is flatter and outlines more pronounced. Tiny side-view eyes have limited readability at128px. Pixel foot bottoms have stair steps and dark border pixels. Palette and apparent proportions are simplified,not exact painted-pixel copies of the normal.

Palette roles remain sage #92B9A0 body scales,cream #E8D6AD feet/connections,and blue-gray #405B6A scale edges/eyes/rear end,with generated light/shadow variations rather than exact flat hex patches. Warmth and saturation of the small pixel feet/connections differ slightly across views.

All16 selected assets derive from16 successful image returns:8 normal and8 pixel. NE pixel uses a second global32-color MAXCOVERAGE derivation of the same generated raw after its first MEDIANCUT derivation had weak rear blue-gray separation; alpha and visible shape were identical and no extra image call was made. Both derived versions are retained privately. W raw included an unwanted translucent glow; the standard global alpha128 binary threshold removed it without a location-specific mask or repaint. The raw and initial quality note are retained. No safety refusal or unresolved generation response occurred in this new branch.
Game runtime,animation,device-scale readability and gameplay integration have not been tested.
